sn4.4:1.2: The Buddha had come to Varanasi after his Awakening to teach the five ascetics ([sn56.11]()). This event is also preserved at [pli-tv-kd1:13.1.1]().
sn4.4:2.1: “Rational application of mind and rational right effort” is _yoniso manasikārā yoniso sammappadhānā_. The term _yoniso_ (“by way of womb”) indicates that the cause and effect are aligned.
